objective: Identify literature-supported dimensions of article-level scientific novelty and select publication-time indicators that are reproducible with the currently audited ASPR reference data.

included: Article-level scientific novelty observable at publication time.
Element novelty and recombinational novelty measured from references, concepts, keywords, entities, or publication text.
Contribution-locus labels such as question, method, theory, and result novelty, recorded as subtypes rather than parallel computational mechanisms.
Independent validation and adverse evidence about novelty indicators.
excluded_from_final_dimensions: Future citation impact, disruption, diffusion, or later reuse.
Interdisciplinarity and knowledge-base diversity when they are not independently shown to measure novelty.
Author, institution, venue prestige, attention, acceptance, quality, and feasibility.
Dynamic LLM judgments without a frozen model, prompt, retrieval corpus, and deterministic aggregation rule.
claim_boundary.interpretation: The output is a publication-time novelty-evidence profile, not a complete judgment of scientific worth, correctness, importance, or future impact.

discovery_anchors: Zhao and Zhang (2025) review of academic-paper novelty measurement
Shibayama et al. (2021) taxonomy of citation/text and element/recombination approaches
Shibayama et al. (2023) explicit distinction between element and recombinant novelty
review_design.screening_unit: A peer-reviewed article, or a foundational mathematical source, that defines, operationalizes, validates, or critiques an article-level novelty measure.
review_design.metric_extraction_unit: A mathematical measurement family. Pure parameter choices and monotone transformations are stored as variants, not counted as new indicator families.

source_inclusion_rules: The source has a DOI or stable version-of-record URL.
The source defines, applies, validates, or directly critiques an article-level novelty construct or a neighboring construct needed for discriminant screening.
An original or paper-level application source is required for a metric family; a review alone cannot authorize a formula.
Adverse and null evidence is retained.
Post-publication measures may enter the census only as explicit exclusions.

dimension_rules.note: Research group, rather than paper count, is used to reduce double-counting of closely related publications.

data_boundary.maximum_information_time: publication_year-1 for historical comparison data; focal references and focal metadata may be observed at publication
audited_local_modalities: strictly prior same-field comparison-paper reference sets
not_audited_or_not_frozen_for_selection: complete title-and-abstract histories with a frozen cross-domain embedding model
question, method, theory, and result entity extraction
author essays or expert novelty labels for the full target corpus

local_audit_provenance.reuse_boundary: Only outcome-blind coverage, stability, temporal, toy, and formula-equivalence fields were transcribed. Existing angle labels and final roles were not reused.
